title: feat(platform-objects,mcp): a member's agent finds a colleague through the read-only sys_user
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoCKSVdjmoh8LwNUuij5uzMu)_

epic:#32897#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzL1RvtJP7jM7QZJaF

Fixes #32641

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`sys_user` 声明了 `enable.aiReadable: true`。成员的 MCP 代理现在能用现有的 `query_records` / `get_record` 按邮箱或姓名找到同事、拿到用户 id，去填「负责人 / 审批人 / 员工」这类人员字段。没有新工具，任何写工具仍拒绝 `sys_user`。`query_records` 的说明和下发的 SKILL.md 教代理：按邮箱找唯一一个人；重名时用邮箱区分。
- **为什么改**：你裁了 B（6844187236）：代理看到的和该成员在控制台人员选择器里看到的一样，同组织、只含通讯录字段；邮箱可见（6867150851）。
- **风险与回滚**：代理拿到的字段＝控制台成员能读到的整行，减去 `Admin` 组：id、姓名、邮箱、邮箱已验证、两步验证开关、停用标记、头像、语言、上级、主业务单元、账号类型（人/AI）、责任人、来源、创建/更新时间。登录记录、锁定、封禁原因、登录手机号、AI 席位等 `Admin` 组字段不给，按它筛选也被拒；别的组织的用户查不到。**这比 option B 原文「只有姓名/邮箱」宽**，座位已就此问你（卡上 6867361507）；若你要只留 id/姓名/邮箱，需要新加一条只针对代理的屏蔽规则，那是另一个决定。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**：① `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` 的 `aiReadable: true` 与注释；② `packages/qa/dogfood/test/colleague-lookup-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`（端到端：找人、跨组织不可见、Admin 组被屏蔽、写被拒、填人员字段）；③ `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` 新加的「People are `sys_user` records」一条。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/colleague-lookup-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 10 条全过。
- **需要你做的**：回答座位的字段集问题（控制台同款 / 只留 id、姓名、邮箱）；在你回答前本 PR 不落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`**: `enable.aiReadable: true` (the mechanism PR #33117 landed, `3eac63a9`). Both MCP bridges already attest it through `isAiReadExposed`, so the five read tools (`list_objects`, `describe_object`, `query_records`, `get_record`, `aggregate_records`) admit `sys_user`; the write tools keep the plain `sys_*` guard. No code change in the admission.
- **No permission change.** `member_default` already grants `sys_user` `allowRead` (`default-permission-sets.ts`, the `sys_user` object entry), scopes rows with `sys_user_self` + `sys_user_org_members` (`id in current_user.org_user_ids`), and withholds the `Admin` field group with `identityAdminFieldSecurity('withhold')`. Those are exactly the gates the console person picker (`UserField` → `PeoplePicker` → `useRecordQuery`, no field projection) is served through, so the agent's read and the picker's read are the same read.
- **What an agent is told.** `query_records`' description: "To fill a person field, find the colleague's id: objectName "sys_user", where {"email":"..."} for exactly one person, or {"name":{"$contains":"..."}}; names repeat, so tell people who share a name apart by email." The served `SKILL.md` (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`) gains a Conventions bullet saying the same, plus "ask your human which one if unsure", and its `list_objects` line no longer says every system object is hidden. The Console "Download skill" copy (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts`) carries the same two edits, because `skill-md.test.ts` holds it byte-identical to the served render.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` (the default-exposure bullet names `sys_user`, what is served, that names repeat) and `packages/mcp/README.md` (the `list_objects` line names both declared objects).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/32641-sys-user-ai-readable.md`: `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/mcp`, `@object-ui/console` patch, both declaration lines, the served field list.

### The served field set (measured, live row)

For a plain member, on a colleague's row, over MCP and at the HTTP data door alike: `accountable_user_id, banned, created_at, email, email_verified, id, image, locale, manager_id, name, primary_business_unit_id, principal_kind, source, two_factor_enabled, updated_at`. That is every declared field outside the `Admin` group; the dogfood pins it as "declared minus `Admin` group", read off the declaration, so a field moved into or out of the group moves the pin with it.

## Tests

- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/colleague-lookup-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`** (new, 10 tests). Real `SecurityPlugin`, real `MCPServerPlugin`, the live `/mcp` transport; no permission set in the file names `sys_user` (members hold the shipped baseline and an app set naming the app's one object). Fixture: a member, two colleagues who share one name, and a third user of that name moved into another organization (membership and sessions); synthetic `Admin` group values on one colleague. Armed controls: the group is non-empty and covers the fixture fields; the values are at rest; the outsider is in another organization and the name matches three rows at rest.
  - by name, the member finds exactly the two colleagues and tells them apart by email; `$contains` on a partial name, the same two; by email, exactly one id;
  - the outsider is invisible: by name, by email (empty), in the unfiltered list, by id (`get_record` refused, no email leaked), by count (`n: 2`);
  - the `Admin` group: not on the served row, not on a projection naming it, and a filter on `failed_login_count` is refused; control: the platform admin's `get_record` is served `last_login_ip`;
  - the agent's `query_records` and the member's `GET /data/sys_user` return the same ids and the same field set, which equals the declared non-`Admin` fields;
  - `create_record`, `update_record` (own row and a colleague's), `delete_record`, `delete_records` are each refused with the system-object sentence, and nothing changed at rest;
  - the `query_records` text names `sys_user` and `email`;
  - end to end: find by email, `create_record` on the app object with `assignee` = the found id, the stored row holds it.
- **`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-ai-read.test.ts`** (new, 2): the declaration and `isAiReadExposed`; `apiMethods` unchanged.
- **`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts`** (+1 describe): the served skill's bullet names `query_records`, `"email"`, `$contains`, "tell them apart by email", "read only"; the old "are hidden" claim is gone. The existing byte-identity pin holds the Console copy.
- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-read-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`**: its `list_objects` pin said `sys_approval_request` is the only listed `sys_*` object; it now lists `sys_approval_request` and `sys_user`.

### Ablations

Each on a committed head with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold`, the package rebuilt, `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` proving the mutation in `dist/` before the run and gone after the restore, restore proved `blob == HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` empty.

| Ablation | Result |
|:--|:--|
| A1: the `aiReadable: true` line deleted (platform-objects rebuilt). This is also the measurement of `main` | declaration pin red (1 failed, 1 passed); dogfood 8 failed, 2 passed, every read answering `Object "sys_user" is a system object and is not exposed via MCP` (the two still green: the write refusals and the tool text) |
| A2: `sys_user_org_members` widened to `true` (plugin-security rebuilt; the anchor occurs three times, member, viewer and external sets, all mutated) | dogfood 2 failed, 8 passed: the name lookup returns three ids, the outsider appears |
| A3: `member_default` keeps the `Admin` group (`identityAdminFieldSecurity` keep, plugin-security rebuilt) | dogfood 2 failed, 8 passed: the withheld-group pin (13 group fields served) and the console-set pin |
| A4: `update_record` uses the read guard (mcp rebuilt) | dogfood 1 failed, 9 passed: `update_record` on `sys_user` answered a record |

A4's first try used a comment as the marker, which the bundler strips, so the preflight refused it and nothing ran; the second used an identifier. A2's first try used an anchor that occurs three times without `--expect 3`, so nothing was written and the run was void; it was rerun with `--expect 3`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The field-set fork is open.** The ruling record 6844187236 says "exactly what that member sees in the console's person picker … directory fields only (#21237)"; option B's own text and triage's 6867150851 say "name/email only" / "no other `sys_user` field is visible". The existing gates serve the console set above (15 fields). Narrowing the agent to id/name/email needs a new agent-only mask that the console does not use. This PR builds the console reading and contains no such mask; the seat has put the question to the maintainer (6867361507). If the answer is id/name/email only, this comes back as a fork.
- **Clause-② derivation.** The five MCP read tools refused `sys_user` on `main` (A1 is that state, measured); after this PR they serve it. Widening only: no tool, schema, export or answer shape narrows.
- **Metadata-protocol derivation.** `enable.aiReadable` already exists (spec #32865); this declares a value on a platform object. No authorable key, value or type is added, narrowed or changed in meaning.
- **Not in the file surface the claim names, changed as consequences:** `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts` (held byte-identical to `skill-md.ts` by `skill-md.test.ts`) and `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-read-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` (its pin listed the `sys_*` set this PR grows).
- **stdio.** The stdio bridge answers `aiReadExposed` with the same `isAiReadExposed`, so a stdio host admits `sys_user` too; the row and field gates there are the sibling card's (#33156 / #33030) scope and are not pinned here.
- **Not touched:** `skills/**` (Tier H). The served MCP skill is `skill-md.ts`, which carries the ruling-6867150851 sentence.
- **Dogfood full battery:** not run (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm); the two MCP dogfood files that read this surface ran, 20/20.

## Verification

Local, on head `1e1c1561`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` 122 files / 1957 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` (after merging `main`) 64 / 1141 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/colleague-lookup-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts test/approval-read-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` 2 files / 20 tests passed (after merging `main`).
- typecheck: platform-objects 0, mcp 0, dogfood 0 (the dogfood one at an 8 GiB heap: the default 4 GiB OOMs, exit 134).
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 100 commands, each with stdin closed) and `pnpm lint`: all exit 0. Three exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured) on the first pass and exit 0 on a rerun after the precondition was met: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:skill-examples` (packages without `dist/`, built), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its pinned fixture commit, fetched into this shallow clone). `--ran` reconciliation: 100 derived, 100 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every line carries its exit code); `pnpm lint` recorded outside the derivation.
